en.headline: Police arrest two men over phishing texts that netted more than HK$500,000
en.dek: Officers found 110 SIM cards and a modem pool in a hotel room used to send nearly 2,000 scam messages about undelivered parcels and insurance fees.
body: Commercial Crime Bureau officers arrested two mainland men aged 31 and 44 on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud after raiding a hotel room used as a phishing operation centre.

Police seized 110 local SIM cards, nine mobile phones and a device known as a ‘cat pool’ that can send large volumes of messages from multiple numbers. Nearly 2,000 phishing texts had already been sent, some linked to at least five reported cases involving more than HK$500,000.

The messages claimed parcels had failed delivery or that payment platforms required fees for unexpected insurance plans, directing victims to transfer money to designated accounts. The suspects remain in custody and further arrests have not been ruled out.

zh.headline: 警拘兩男涉發釣魚短訊騙逾50萬 檢110張電話卡
zh.dek: 商罪科在酒店房檢獲「貓池」裝置及近2000條已發短訊，兩名內地男子涉嫌串謀詐騙被捕。
body: 商業罪案調查科前日在一間酒店房間拘捕兩名分別31歲及44歲內地男子，涉嫌串謀詐騙。
人員檢獲110張本地電話卡、9部手提電話及一部可同時插入多卡的「貓池」裝置。手機內發現近2000條已發釣魚短訊，部分與最少五宗報案有關，涉款逾50萬元。
短訊內容訛稱速遞派送失敗或支付平台需收手續費處理意外開通保險，要求受害人轉帳至指定戶口。兩人正被扣留調查，不排除有更多人被捕。
